cloze.sentence: ____, the government should invest far more in public transport.

____, the benefits of this policy clearly outweigh its drawbacks.

____, universities should place more emphasis on practical skills.

translate.source: Theo ý kiến của tôi, chính phủ nên cấm quảng cáo thuốc lá.

scenario: In a formal IELTS Task 2 essay, state your view on whether zoos should be banned. (formal, academic)
You are texting a friend about a phone you just tried. Give your honest view. (casual, informal)
During a class debate, politely offer your view on school uniforms. (semi-formal, polite)
Writing an online review of a laptop you bought, share your view of it. (neutral, consumer review)
In a work meeting, give your view on switching to a four-day week. (professional, measured)
Commenting under a news article about climate policy, state your view. (public, respectful)
In a university seminar, express your view on the assigned reading. (academic, tentative)
Advising a younger sibling about choosing a university major, give your view. (warm, supportive)
In an opinion paragraph for homework, argue whether homework should be abolished. (formal, structured)
In a friendly group chat planning a trip, say which destination you prefer. (light, informal)

cloze.sentence: ____, the real problem is a lack of long-term planning.
The changes seem positive, at least ____, as a daily commuter.
____, both economic growth and the environment matter equally.
As a teacher, ____, smaller classes make a huge difference.
____, the media often exaggerates the dangers of new technology.
The decision looks unfair ____, though I understand the reasons.
____, remote work has improved my quality of life enormously.

____, the policy addresses the symptoms rather than the cause.

translate.source: Theo quan điểm của tôi, giáo dục miễn phí nên được coi là quyền cơ bản.
Theo quan điểm của tôi, thành phố cần nhiều không gian xanh hơn.

scenario: In an academic essay, introduce your standpoint on whether AI threatens jobs. (formal, academic)
In a job interview, share how you see teamwork based on your experience. (professional, confident)
Discussing a film with friends, explain how you personally saw it. (casual, relaxed)

Chatting with classmates about a new school rule, give your take. (informal, friendly)

____ every citizen has a duty to vote in elections.
____ renewable energy is the only sustainable path forward.
____ hard work matters far more than natural talent.
____ governments should guarantee free healthcare for all.

translate.source: Tôi tin chắc rằng giáo dục nên miễn phí cho mọi người.

scenario: Opening an IELTS opinion essay, state your strong stance on capital punishment. (formal, academic)

translate.source: Công việc rất khó; tuy nhiên, họ vẫn hoàn thành đúng hạn.
Anh ấy ít kinh nghiệm; dù vậy, vẫn được nhận vào làm.
Trời mưa cả ngày; tuy nhiên, chúng tôi vẫn thấy vui.
Chi phí rất cao; dù vậy, lợi ích vẫn xứng đáng.
Cô ấy kiệt sức; tuy nhiên, cô vẫn về đích.
The evidence is weak; nevertheless, many people believe it.
The road was long. Nevertheless, they pressed on.
The plan has flaws; nevertheless, it is our best option.
Nevertheless, the company decided to expand overseas.
The film was slow; nevertheless, the ending was powerful.

scenario: In a formal essay, concede a point yet maintain your position. (formal, academic)
In a report, acknowledge a difficulty but affirm success. (professional, measured)
In a recommendation, admit a drawback yet still advise going ahead. (professional, balanced)
In a debate, grant an opposing fact but hold your stance. (semi-formal, firm)
In a review, note a flaw yet still praise overall. (neutral, fair)
In an inspiring speech, admit hardship but stress perseverance. (public, uplifting)
In an academic discussion, accept limited data yet defend a claim. (academic, cautious)
Encouraging a friend, admit the odds yet urge them on. (informal, supportive)
In an editorial, acknowledge criticism but restate your view. (public, steady)
In a cover letter, admit a gap yet emphasise your strengths. (professional, confident)

translate.source: Sống ở thành phố tiện lợi; mặt khác, chi phí lại rất cao.
Học trực tuyến linh hoạt; mặt khác, dễ khiến ta mất tập trung.
Ô tô nhanh chóng; mặt khác, chúng gây ô nhiễm không khí.

scenario: In a discussion essay, present the opposing viewpoint after the first. (formal, academic)
In a pros-and-cons paragraph, introduce the disadvantages. (academic, balanced)
In a report, contrast a benefit with a matching drawback. (professional, objective)
Advising a friend on a choice, lay out the other side. (informal, thoughtful)
In a debate, fairly present the counter-argument. (semi-formal, measured)
In a product comparison, weigh one option against another. (neutral, informative)
In an op-ed, balance your point with an opposing consideration. (public, fair)
In a meeting, weigh a plan's downside against its upside. (professional, balanced)
